description: This file defines a helper class Size used for parsing and representing size dimensions with units (pt, px, em) within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: Size
classes.description: A helper class for validating, storing, and formatting a size value with units within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a Size object by parsing the provided size string and validating it against a regex.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Returns whether the size string was valid according to the regex.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size component of the size string.

methods.name: unit
methods.description: Returns the unit component of the size string.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the size and unit combined as a string.
